scope: 155-operator evidence loop expression for Contract, Golden, Dataset, Field replay, Precision Claim, and Industrial Status.

machineAudit.jsonValidity: Must parse as strict JSON before publishing.
machineAudit.requiredIndustrialPendingToken: 功能可用但未完成现场工业验证
machineAudit.industrialClaimBoundary: No operator is marked as real industrial validation complete; field replay substitute evidence is not real production-site sign-off.
machineAudit.localClosureBoundary: External real production-site data, customer sign-off, and line sign-off cannot be closed locally. Local evidence can only keep this blocker explicit and auditable.

evidenceLayers.minimumAcceptance: Happy path, missing input, parameter boundary, type/null boundary, structured failure message, recorded case count, zero accepted-run failures.

evidenceLayers.meaning: Synthetic oracle, geometry oracle, protocol oracle, or fixed regression baseline evidence.
evidenceLayers.minimumAcceptance: At least 20 deterministic oracle/regression cases where applicable, fixed runner or baseline, recorded runtime/memory, zero accepted-run failures.

evidenceLayers.meaning: Public/licensed/semi-synthetic/curated dataset-tier evidence with manifest and metrics.
evidenceLayers.minimumAcceptance: Manifest with source/version or seed, deterministic split, metric thresholds, failure/boundary taxonomy, reproducible runner, and accepted baseline result.
evidenceLayers.currentGap: 134 operators are Not yet evidenced; 1 operator is partially evidenced.

evidenceLayers.meaning: Anonymized or field-substitute replay evidence with triage and regression conversion.
evidenceLayers.minimumAcceptance: Replay manifest, replay command, triage labels, reproducible rate >= 0.80, regressionized rate >= 0.60, privacy/path leak checks, accepted baseline result.
evidenceLayers.currentGap: 150 operators are Not yet evidenced; 5 operators have substitute replay only.

evidenceLayers.meaning: Strongest currently supported precision basis per operator.
evidenceLayers.minimumAcceptance: Claim must name the strongest evidence basis or say Not yet evidenced; it must not imply real-site validation unless industrial status supports it.
evidenceLayers.currentGap: 99 contract-only claims and 35 golden-only claims need dataset/field promotion; 0 are Not yet evidenced.

evidenceLayers.minimumAcceptance: Real-site anonymized data or customer/line sign-off, replayable manifest, stable thresholds, and regressionized failures.
evidenceLayers.currentGap: 155 operators remain 功能可用但未完成现场工业验证; no operator has completed real industrial validation in this matrix.
